invariants_checked: gRPC server authentication fails closed unless GRPC_AUTH_TOKEN is configured (or DOCREADER_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED=true is explicitly set for isolated local dev/test), compares tokens in constant time via hmac.compare_digest, and accepts RFC-6750 case-insensitive Bearer prefixes.

DocReaderConfig enforces positive integer bounds on gRPC worker counts, raw file size / gRPC message size caps, listen ports (1-65535), PDF render DPI/parallelism, OpenDataLoader heap/timeouts, and subprocess image-preprocessing limits.

Unary Read and streaming ReadStream RPCs scrub URL userinfo credentials, Bearer tokens, sk-* keys, and api_key/secret/password parameters from logs, tracebacks, and error responses while replacing lone UTF-16 surrogates across markdown, metadata, error payloads, and SourceBlock locator_json.

Image preprocessing runs in isolated, non-blocking socket-supervised child processes with PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, RLIMIT_AS, RSS supervision, MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS=40_000_000, and empty-crop guards; ARM OpenSSL SIGILL startup probe uses os.execvpe safely with zero upstream brand or host-path residues.

findings.summary: Read and ReadStream logged raw request.url and exception tracebacks and returned unredacted str(e) in ReadResponse.error / ReadStreamMeta.error (leaking URL credentials, Bearer tokens, and API keys), and lone UTF-16 surrogates in exception strings or SourceBlock locator_json raised UnicodeEncodeError during protobuf serialization.

load_config() accepted zero/negative env values for DOCREADER_GRPC_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB (producing <=0 or -1 unlimited gRPC receive caps), DOCREADER_GRPC_MAX_WORKERS, DOCREADER_GRPC_PORT, DOCREADER_PDF_RENDER_DPI, and DOCREADER_PDF_RENDER_PARALLELISM; AuthInterceptor rejected lowercase/uppercase RFC-6750 'bearer ' prefixes; and preprocess_worker lacked an explicit MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS=40_000_000 ceiling and empty-crop guard.

invariants_checked: LoadAuthConfigFromEnv parses GRPC_TLS_ENABLED case-insensitively with whitespace trimming (true/1/yes/on, matching Python server _env_bool) and trims mounted secret/cert paths so K8s newline-padded env vars never silently downgrade TLS to plaintext.

EffectiveForAddr and IsTrustedDocReaderAddr scope GRPC_AUTH_TOKEN strictly to the operator-configured DOCREADER_ADDR (or loopback when unset), normalizing dns:/// and passthrough:/// schemes and FQDN trailing dots before ports while rejecting embedded URL userinfo.

Client honors DOCREADER_GRPC_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB before MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB, rejects empty dial addresses, masks credentials in connection logs, synchronizes SetDebug/Log via atomic.Bool, and guards Close() on nil connections.

findings.summary: LoadAuthConfigFromEnv checked os.Getenv("GRPC_TLS_ENABLED") == "true" without trimming or case/numeric normalization (silently downgrading TLS to plaintext and disabling RequireTransportSecurity on 'TRUE', '1', or trailing-newline secrets), and normalizeDocReaderAddr failed to strip dns:/// or passthrough:/// schemes, failed to trim FQDN trailing dots before ':port', and accepted URLs containing embedded userinfo.

getMaxFileSize() ignored DOCREADER_GRPC_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB and untrimmed env values, NewClientWithAuth dialed 'dns:///' on blank addresses and logged unmasked userinfo credentials, Close() panicked on nil conn, and Client.debug raced between SetDebug and Log under -race.

invariants_checked: Document, Chunk, and ChunkingConfig schemas preserve backward-compatible serialization, non-mutating deserialization, and safe equality semantics across non-Chunk comparisons.

findings.summary: Chunk.__eq__ accessed other.content unconditionally (raising AttributeError when compared against None or non-Chunk objects instead of returning NotImplemented), and Chunk.from_dict mutated the caller's input dictionary in place via update() and pop('class_name').

invariants_checked: All ZIP/OOXML/EPUB/XMind archive admissions enforce entry count, compression ratio, member/cumulative decompressed byte ceilings across STORED, DEFLATED, BZIP2, and LZMA streams (including LZMA dictionary header bounds <= 64 MiB), and XML parsers disable entity resolution and network access (defusedxml / lxml resolve_entities=False, no_network=True).

Pillow Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS=40_000_000 is enforced at package import across in-process and subprocess parsers; ImageMagick delegates are restricted to raster formats with resource caps; LibreOffice conversions run inside clean-env + bwrap --unshare-net sandboxes with symlink and output-size checks.

WebParser routes all Playwright browser traffic through SSRFProxy + route guards with proxy fallback support, and OpenDataLoader hybrid health/forwarder requests enforce SSRF validation, DNS-rebinding IP pinning, ProxyHandler({}), no-redirect handling, and bounded upstream response reads.

PDFium native operations are serialized under _PDFIUM_LOCK (always acquired after render semaphores), RapidOCR instances are isolated in threading.local(), and ArchiveLimitError / ParserCancelled propagate without triggering fallback parsers or leaking temporary files/directories.

findings.summary: _stream_zip_entry_bounded omitted zipfile.ZIP_LZMA, causing spoofed-file_size LZMA zip bombs to fall back to stdlib ZipExtFile.read() (which decompresses unbounded LZMA streams in C without max_length, raised BadZipFile on truncated CRC, and was silently ignored by verify_zip_stream_limits) and allowing multi-hundred-MiB LZMA dictionary header allocations; XMindParser also read ZIP entries directly instead of safe_read_zip_member and lacked a topic recursion depth cap.

DocxParser and EPUBParser caught broad Exception and swallowed ParserCancelled/ArchiveLimitError into fallback parsers; DocxParser leaked NamedTemporaryFile/mkdtemp image directories when write() or image.save() failed or exceptions interrupted page collection; and DocParser/excel_convert/ppt_convert lacked symlink (in DocParser) and converted-file size guards before reading LibreOffice output into memory.

OpenDataLoader _ping_hybrid inherited ambient proxy env vars and both _ping_hybrid and _local_hybrid_auth_proxy re-resolved DNS on connect after is_ssrf_safe_url (DNS-rebinding TOCTOU), _local_hybrid_auth_proxy called unbounded resp.read() on upstream responses, and StdWebParser ignored CONFIG.external_http_proxy when external_https_proxy was unset.

invariants_checked: TextSplitter enforces chunk_size > 0, chunk_overlap >= 0, and chunk_overlap < chunk_size, terminates _split() without infinite recursion when an unsplittable multi-byte unit exceeds chunk_size, resets HeaderTracker state per split_text() call, formats oversized-split/header error logs cleanly, and skips duplicate/contained ranges in restore_text().

findings.summary: TextSplitter accepted chunk_size <= 0, chunk_overlap < 0, and chunk_overlap == chunk_size, infinitely recursed in _split() when a single character's custom length_function exceeded chunk_size, passed two positional strings with zero format placeholders to logger.error() (causing logging TypeError), leaked active HeaderTracker table headers across consecutive split_text() calls, and duplicated chunks in restore_text() when end_pos <= last_end.

invariants_checked: is_ssrf_safe_url enforces http/https schemes only, rejects backslashes in authority/path, embedded URL credentials, IPv6 zone/percent characters, shorthand/octal/hex numeric IPv4 literals, private/loopback/link-local/metadata/NAT64/6to4/Teredo IPs, and validates port bounds (1-65535) and BLOCKED_PORTS even on whitelisted hostnames.

SSRFProxy pins resolved numeric IPs at socket connection time across redirects, handles malformed upstream proxy status lines without unhandled IndexError, and awaits stream transport closure cleanly.

TempFileContext strips path separators and null bytes from suffixes, closes file descriptors before yielding to external converters, and guarantees unlink on enter/exit failures; request_id_context scrubs CR/LF/control characters against log injection.

findings.summary: is_ssrf_safe_url permitted backslashes in URL authority (allowing WHATWG vs urlparse differential SSRF such as http://169.254.169.254\@example.com/), permitted embedded userinfo, skipped port bounds and BLOCKED_PORTS checks on whitelisted hosts, and missed shorthand/octal/hex IPv4 forms (127.1, 0, 017700000001, 127.0x0.0.1) before DNS; SSRFProxy._connect raised unhandled IndexError on malformed upstream proxy status lines.

TempFileContext passed unsanitized suffixes to NamedTemporaryFile (failing or traversing on '/' or '\' in caller-supplied filenames) and left the writable fd open during context body execution, TempDirContext lacked ignore_cleanup_errors=True, and request_id_context logged raw CR/LF control characters from untrusted ReadRequest.request_id.
